source_refs.note: Procedure of Titration: a main subheading of 16.5 Acid-base titration, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 340-341.

items: Pipette ko pehle distilled water se, phir diye gaye NaOH solution se dhoyein (rinse karein).
Conical flask ko sirf distilled water se dhoyein.
Pipette se 10 cm³ NaOH solution conical flask mein dalein.
Is mein phenolphthalein indicator ke ek ya do qatre dalein. Solution gulabi (pink) ho jata hai.
Burette ko pehle distilled water se, phir diye gaye HCl solution se dhoyein.
Burette ko clamp stand par bilkul seedha (upright) lagayein.
Funnel ki madad se burette mein HCl solution bharein, phir funnel nikal dein.
Burette ke neeche wali tap khol kar thora acid beaker mein girayein taake nozzle mein phansa hawa ka bulbula nikal jaye.
Anti-parallax card ya safed kaghaz ki madad se burette ki reading parhein; yeh initial (pehli) reading hai.
Titration ke dauran conical flask ko burette ke neeche safed kaghaz par rakhein taake indicator ka rang badalna saaf nazar aaye. Dekh lein ke burette se leak na ho.
Burette se hydrochloric acid qatra qatra flask mein dal kar ek rough (andaze wali) titration karein.
Acid dalte waqt flask ko ghumate (swirl karte) rahein taake sab achhi tarah mil jaye.
Acid tab tak dalte rahein jab tak gulabi rang bilkul ghayab ho kar solution be-rang (colourless) na ho jaye. Yahi reaction ka end point hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke step xiii mein likha hai ke acid tab tak dalein jab tak rang 'light pink persistently' ho jaye. Yahan NaOH flask mein hai aur phenolphthalein ki wajah se shuru se gulabi hai; acid dalne se end point par gulabi rang ghayab ho kar solution be-rang (colourless) ho jata hai. Is liye sahi: acid tab tak dalein jab tak gulabi rang bilkul ghayab na ho jaye aur solution be-rang rahe. Kitab ka 'Did you know' bhi kehta hai ke pH girne par rang gulabi se be-rang hota hai.
Ab dobara burette ki reading parhein; yeh final (aakhri) reading hai. Final aur initial reading ka farq istemal hue acid ka volume hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch steps: pipette se acid solution conical flask mein; dropper se indicator dala jata hai; burette ki initial reading aur tap band (Hold); tap khol kar (Release) burette se qatre flask mein; final reading, tap band, aur flask ka solution gulabi (pink).

blocks.text: Sahi aur concordant (aapas mein milti hui) readings ke liye titration dohrayein. Kam az kam teen concordant readings lein jo aapas mein 0.1 cm³ ke andar hon.
